pull_request.body:
Task request: https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/118
Label request: `118-35344007412`

Refs #118 and #117; request `118-35344007412`, assessed at `da94b693a0034cb211e96f42dee83970deb59886`.

The requested study is blocked: the configured environment lacks Key4hep/Gaudi/Marlin. No original-framework comparison or new digitized MIP, threshold-efficiency or e/gamma plots were produced.

This follow-up adds `docs/validation/issue117/pr118-review-request.md`, links it from the preparation README, updates calorimeter tracking, refreshes `interactions/pr-0118.json`, and adds a paired curated session record. Existing geometry evidence is preserved. DES-044 remains DRAFT/PROTOTYPE; no detector parameters or source-manifest entries changed.

Actual checks:

- DD4hep/DDG4 imports and all twelve Geant4 dataset presence checks passed after the stale-fingerprint preflight warning.
- Required reference-runtime probe failed, confirming the blocker.
- Session validation, interaction validation, token-site validation and final preview build passed. A transient stale-fingerprint preview failure is retained in the journal.
- Whitespace and six-file content/size audits passed; no raw reference-run data was added.
- Project-record validation failed because this isolated Git store lacks pre-existing PR #37 merge evidence `78bc60bb6da0c9d234baf00d37cadea9dd4964b4`. Native CTest and physics studies were not run.

Human input remains necessary: provide a usable pinned RecCaloDigi runtime or independently produced same-hit reference, and decide the proposed endcap geometry issue/PR split. Exact task token counters were unavailable; usage remains unestimated.

events.text:
Original-framework comparison is blocked in the configured environment.
DD4hep/DDG4/Geant4 presence does not provide Key4hep/Gaudi or its RecCaloDigi
plugin. Neither the existing standalone original-method harness nor synthetic
comparison tests can substitute for that independent event processor. No
transport, digitization, photon/muon campaign, new plot or geometry change was
performed. Earlier tests and plots remain historical evidence.

The report maps all reviewer requests to still-needed evidence, with units,
denominators, calibration and stochastic-comparison caveats inherited from the
existing plan. Prior endcap evidence is preserved in its separate report. No
issue was opened or split imposed; maintainer issue/PR disposition and a usable
reference runtime remain required. The previous human deferral remains visible
and conditional on appropriate software being available.
DES-044 remains DRAFT/PROTOTYPE without sign-off or acceptance.
